questions.q: According to the book, depression is linked to living in which time frame?
questions.why: It states depressed people are living in the past.

questions.q: What practice does Thich Nhat Hanh recommend weekly?
questions.why: He recommends devoting at least one day a week to mindfulness practice.

questions.q: How does the book describe the role of breathing in mindfulness?
a: A bridge connecting consciousness to the present
A way to increase lung capacity
A method to control heart rate
questions.why: Breathing is described as a bridge that connects consciousness to the right now.

questions.q: What distinguishes mindful rest from napping, per the text?
a: Mindful rest is alert and aware; napping is half‑conscious
Napping is more mindful than rest
questions.why: Mindful rest is alert and awake, whereas napping is a half‑conscious lazy state.

questions.q: What does the book suggest is the cause of over‑thinking?
a: Blurring line between preparedness and excess thought
questions.why: Over‑thinking arises when the line between preparedness and over‑thinking is blurred.
